_comment: A/B comparison (2026-10-21), A = baseline: bands + URM puzzle embedding, nothing else. data/arc1_ctx10_trans.npz (ARC-AGI-1 training + evaluation tasks whose grids all have sides <= 10: 255 tasks, every one transductive as URM: its train pairs are training pairs, all its test pairs evaluated, 278 evaluation pairs; slots 11x11, up to 5 demonstrations). Episodes in context (up to 5 demonstrations + query, packed). URM versions: 101 per task (v = 0 identity, v >= 1 a fixed dihedral transform and permutation of colors 1..9), identifier task * 101 + v, evaluation v = 0; puzzle embedding 512 as one prefix token (angle 0), SignSGD lr 1e-2, wd 0.1, EMA. 16 blocks per segment, last block with gradients, 8 segments, batch 32. local_conv, frame_rope, rule_path off. B = A + the rule synapse fed by the same embedding (configs/arc1_ctx10_pe_rule.json).
